title: ChatGPT Is Still The King #chatgpt #aiProductivity #promptingTips
description:
Everyone’s buzzing about Claude, Perplexity, Gemini—but ChatGPT still rules. Why? It handles writing, research, brainstorming, coding, marketing, and productivity all in one place. If you’re new to AI, don’t chase every shiny tool. Start simple: learn to prompt well, set clear goals, and make ChatGPT your central assistant. Once you’ve built that foundation, adding specialist tools becomes strategic, not chaotic. AI works best when it’s organized—master one versatile tool first, then expand your toolbox. Follow HeadlessHub for practical, no-fluff AI tips and guidance.
